entities.summary: Estanislau Marques Chindekasse S.V.D., is an Angolan Catholic prelate who is the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Dundo, in Angola, since 22 December 2012. Before that, from 22 November 1987, he was a priest of the Roman Catholic religious Society of the Divine Word. He was appointed bishop by Pope Benedict XVI. He was consecrated bishop on 3 March 2013. He was installed at Dundo on 17 March 2013.
